question: Can one published joint posterior sample supply a numerically consistent mass-resolved host for recoil transport?
interpretation: Reproducible reconstruction using historically compatible code; exact original run versions and input hashes were not recorded in the released chain.
joint_sample_selection: argmax(nested/logwt), first row on a tie; largest posterior quadrature weight, not maximum likelihood or posterior mode

host.tracer_policy: Preserve source tracer contribution to gravity, report it, exclude TR bins from encounters.
host.density_pressure_interpolation: cubic interpolation of log positive profiles; lowering-law taper only after final positive mesh point

validation.projected_profile_comparison: Compare the selected reconstruction with published central 95.45 percent envelopes; this is descriptive, neither a refit nor a goodness-of-fit probability.
validation.projected_species: most massive main-sequence bin used in published kinematic profiles; all-bin differences also retained as diagnostics
validation.interpolation_check: DF integrals validate all bins; log interpolation preserves the positive, steep segregated tails

seed_reason: deterministic joint-row selection and deterministic quadrature
